title: 住
teacherNotes: Release verified and merged L275 from origin/codex/l275-complete-package against latest origin/main. Dependencies are satisfied in playable order through L277; R001-R016 are already shipped.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: Release verified against production JSON through L275.
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for each sentence.
Use L058 lesson images only as illustration style references; do not copy any L058 person, clothing, face, hair, or body shape.
Use protagonist family continuity from docs/LESSON_VISUAL_CAST_SOP.md, docs/CURRICULUM_LEDGER.md, and docs/visual-references/lesson-cast.md.
Every human prompt must explicitly name the role identity.
No written text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, logos, brands, wall writing, or readable marks.
Each image must clearly match its approved image notes and remain phone-readable in a square crop.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate charAudio for 住 as public/assets/lessons/L275/audio/char-u4f4f.m4a from the single character.
Generate G02 prefix/suffix and G05 wrong-option audio as standalone whole-text files from exact text.
Do not splice, cut, mute, patch, or extract production audio.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩住在海邊，從家附近看海上的船。畫面要有海邊住家、主角小女孩、遠處的船；不可有門牌、文字、數字、船名、標籤或注音。
主角小女孩在桌邊想打開一個盒子，但盒子卡住了打不開。盒子不可有文字、數字、標籤或注音。
主角爸爸在家門或房門旁試著推門或拉門，門關太緊卡住了。畫面要清楚是門卡住但安全、不驚嚇；不可有門牌、文字、數字、標籤或注音。
主角小女孩晚上躺在床上，因為精神緊張睡得很差，表情有點擔心但不恐怖。主角媽媽可在旁邊溫和安撫；不可有文字、數字、標籤或注音。

approvedSentences.text: 走到一半，天氣變差，只好回頭。
